newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: More response to Wallis post budget-Australia govt.
newsitem.headline: More response to Wallis post budget-Australia govt.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the government would announce further responses to the Wallis report into the financial sector after the May 13 budget.

Costello released the Wallis report and the government's initial response to key recommendations, including an end to the ban on mergers between the four major Australian banks and two leading life insurance companies.

"The remaining recommendations are recommendations to the government which the government will consider and announce a position on after the budget and after they have been considered," Costello said.
Costello is due to announce the budget for the fiscal year to June 30, 1998, on May 13.
